description: Aventa AV-7 Wind Turbine SCADA Dataset with Simulated Cyberattacks for Anomaly Detection and Cybersecurity Research is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Abdulkarim Amin. This dataset was created for cybersecurity testing of a SCADA anomaly detection system. It originates from the Aventa AV-7 wind turbine dataset (originally 39,715,978 records, cleaned to 35,470,486 records). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
